description:
N-Zik is your ultimate, open-source, and multilingual YouTube Music client for Android! 🎵🚀
As a multilingual fork of Kreate, N-Zik takes the music experience to a whole new level. We've obsessively focused on performance optimizations, stunning UI/UX refinements, bug fixes, and packing the app with an extensive suite of new features—all backed by long-term support.
A Note on Development & Stability:
N-Zik is a side project originally built for myself and friends, not chasing glory. It's grown a bit since then, which is cool! However, it may not yet be as stable as the original Kreate, so feel free to use it or other solid alternatives like Metrolist, VIVI Music, or RiPlay if you need a more mature option.
Transparent AI Usage:
I use generative AI to assist with code, structured with the BMAD Method, but everything gets reviewed and tested before it's pushed. I'm not shipping blind. If AI-assisted development isn't your thing, no hard feelings, there are plenty of great alternatives.
Whether you're a casual listener or a hardcore audiophile, N-Zik gives you absolute control over your music, without compromising your privacy.
✨ WHY CHOOSE N-ZIK? ✨
Unlike standard streaming apps, N-Zik removes the limits. No ads, full background playback, offline caching, and a beautifully customizable interface. It's built for those who want a premium music experience completely for free, powered by the open-source community.
🎨 Stunning & Customizable UI
• Jetpack Compose Magic: A flawlessly smooth, modern, and intuitive interface.
• Classic UI Toggle: Feeling nostalgic? Seamlessly switch between the modern N-Zik experience and the classic ViMusic interface. 🌓
• Custom Themes: Personalize your vibe with carefully crafted presets. Choose between a battery-saving True AMOLED mode, Deep Dark, Crisp Light themes, and beautifully tinted accents.
• 3D Carousel Player: Experience your music playback with a visually breathtaking 3D carousel view! 🎠
• Home Screen Widgets: Control your music right from your launcher with multiple beautiful and customizable new widgets. 🪟
• Detailed Artist Profiles & News Feed: Dive deep into comprehensive artist pages. Explore top tracks, albums, and similar artists. Discover new moods, genres, and latest releases directly from the News Feed! 📰
• Experimental Widgets: Access upcoming UI features and experimental widgets before they become stable! 🧪
🎵 Unmatched Audio Experience
• High-Quality Audio: Connect a YouTube Music Premium account and select the Web Remix client to unlock pure Premium streaming quality on N-Zik! 🔊
• Advanced Lyrics: Sing your heart out! Fetch, display word by word, sync and unsync lyrics with smart fallback mechanisms, edit, and translate them in real-time! 🎤
• Immersive Audio Visualizer: Watch your music come alive with real-time visual effects perfectly synchronized to every beat. 🎇
• Pro Audio Controls: Take command with advanced controls: adjust volume, playback speed, pitch, audio normalization, silence skipping, crossfade, and volume boost. 🎚️
💾 True Offline, Metadata & Privacy
• Smart Offline Caching & Downloads: Automatically cache your listening queue or permanently download individual tracks and entire playlists for offline access. Enjoy your library even without an internet connection! 📡
• Media Export (FFmpeg Powered): Export cached or downloaded music direct
